newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill on Monday, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was fairly good, but present bids of $101.00-$102.00 per cwt were not not interesting cattle feeders who priced stock at $104.00, or better. Last established market was Thursday at $102.00-103.00.
Confirmed: None Last Week: None Last Year: 400
Wk To Date: 1,700 Sm Pd Lst Wk: 1,200 Sm Pd Lst Yr: 500

Live basis sales: Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights) Slaughter Steers: No confirmed sales. Slaughter Heifers: No confirmed sales.
